plugins.name: message-board
plugins.description: Operator Cognition Framework: agents remember, so the operator doesn't have to ask. An agent handoff board — each workstream owns a BRIEF.md in an external Obsidian vault; agents cold-start by reading it, hooks record mechanical ground truth, and a dashboard replaces asking every session for status.
